exposure: 1-hour plasma glucose levels after a 50g oral glucose load test
1 h, 50 g oral glucose load test
cohort: 4119 women from the Boston Birth Cohort (1998-2016), including women with pregestational diabetes (n=307), gestational diabetes (n=582), and without diabetes (n=3230)
finding: In this predominantly Black and Hispanic cohort, moderate maternal glycemia in women without pregestational or gestational diabetes was associated with higher odds of high birth weight and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, particularly among Black women.
